critical.title: Number parsing accepts special string values
critical.description: Query param 'limit=NaN' or 'limit=Infinity' bypasses validation checks
critical.fix: Add isNaN() check before isFinite() validation

critical.title: API key validation regex rejects valid formats
critical.description: Regex /^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{12,256}$/ rejects colons, breaking production API keys like 'project:key'

critical.title: UUID generation logs but doesn't fail in production
critical.description: When crypto APIs unavailable, returns non-secure UUID in production without throwing error
critical.fix: Throw error in production, only fallback in development

critical.title: Meeting schema allows empty attendees array
critical.description: Removed min(1) constraint from attendees array, allowing invalid meetings with zero attendees
critical.fix: Restore min(1) constraint: z.array(EmailSchema).min(1, 'At least one attendee required')

medium.title: Regex character class escaping is ambiguous
medium.description: Password special character regex has non-standard escaping that could fail when ported
medium.fix: Simplify regex and document escaping clearly

medium.title: Defense-in-depth path validation is redundant
medium.description: Multiple checks are redundant by construction - dirname check always passes
medium.fix: Use path.resolve() and verify path starts with base directory

medium.title: Session cookie validation has fallback issues
medium.description: Non-JWT sessions fall back to IP-based rate limiting, potential bypass if JWT stolen
medium.fix: Enforce per-user rate limiting for all authenticated sessions

medium.title: CSRF token parsing failures silently handled
medium.description: Request body parse errors caught silently, malformed requests may bypass body-based CSRF validation
medium.fix: Log parse errors and enforce header token when body invalid

medium.title: Password repeated pattern regex fails for Unicode
medium.description: Regex doesn't handle Unicode normalization - 'Café123café' passes despite being weak
medium.fix: Normalize input before checking repeated patterns

medium.title: CircuitBreaker state not immutable at runtime
medium.description: Internal state marked Readonly but TypeScript doesn't enforce at runtime

blockers.description: atomicReadModifyWrite and atomicTransaction not exported from atomic-file-ops.ts
In-memory rate limiter doesn't work correctly in test environment
Atomic file operations tests fail due to missing exports and lock timing
JWT and session validation edge cases causing test failures

sqlInjection.notes: Parameterized queries, Zod validation, no string concatenation

xss.notes: No dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no innerHTML mutations, no eval()

csrf.notes: Token validation in place, but body parsing failures not handled

authentication.notes: JWT validation good, but fallback to IP rate limiting is weak

dataLeakage.notes: Sensitive data not logged, errors sanitized, RLS policies in place

cryptography.notes: UUID fallback to Math.random() is critical issue

rateLimiting.notes: In-memory only, fails in multi-instance, regex broken

critical: Debug and fix auth middleware tests
